baseline_models.mechanism: Likeness, sustained practice, and a named collective combine into a functional comparison: the peoples are not bare precedents, because their maintained social course becomes a repeatable warning-form.

activation_trace.role: General likeness links the named cases without requiring them to be identical.
Continuous exertion supplies persistence as the mechanism carried across cases.
An ongoing habit turns repeated action into a settled collective course.
The people-group is the social carrier of that continuing course.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely lists earlier peoples as comparable disasters.
changed_reading.after: The ayah compares the present danger to a maintained collective course whose repetition makes history diagnostic.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وما الله يريد ظلما للعباد at words 11-14
baseline_models.mechanism: Negated volition bars assigning zulm to God's intention. With zulm imaged as wrong placement or withheld right and servants placed in a relation of obedient dependence, the clause becomes a causal boundary on how the historical comparison may be read.

activation_trace.role: Will and intention are explicitly the domain under negation.
Putting an act in the wrong place or time broadens injustice beyond undifferentiated harm.
Blocking a due right gives the negation a relational and adjudicative edge.
Humble obedience identifies the humans concerned as agents in a lord-servant relation.

changed_reading.before: The final clause is a generic assurance that God is not cruel.
changed_reading.after: The final clause audits agency: whatever the comparison announces, divine will is not the engine of misplacement or rights-denial toward the servants.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مثل at word 1 qualified by لا يريد ظلما at words 12-13
baseline_models.mechanism: The comparison can make prior peoples into a deterrent example, but the non-zulm clause constrains that warning. Exemplarity is retained while arbitrary mutilation, abuse, or rights-blocking is excluded from its divine rationale.

activation_trace.role: Punitive exemplarity supplies the warning function of the comparison.
An example as a sign makes the past usable for present recognition.
The prohibition on withholding right bounds how punishment-as-example can function.
Dependents under ownership sharpen the asymmetry that makes arbitrary abuse a live concern.

changed_reading.before: The destroyed peoples are simply frightening examples.
changed_reading.after: Their fate is a deterrent exemplum under an explicit anti-arbitrariness constraint, not a display of unchecked power over dependents.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier Noah-and-parties scene specifies the collective course as resolved coercion: each community forms an intent, seeks to seize its messenger, twists dispute, and tries to dislodge truth; the same occurrence record then turns seizure back upon them and names punishment after wrongdoing.

activation_trace.role: Sustained exertion anchors the delta in the focus ayah's continuing course.
Resolved intention supplies the internal commitment that precedes collective action.
The two captures supply a mirrored sequence: attempted seizure of the messenger and answering seizure of the people.
Twisted contention gives the course a discursive mechanism rather than mere disbelief.
Displacing something from its place renders the attempted removal of truth as enacted misplacement.
Stable correspondence to reality marks what their dispute tries to overturn.
Punishment following offense supplies the consequence-side of the mechanism.

structural_cues: 40:5 names Noah's people and later parties in the same before-and-after series resumed at 40:31.
Within 40:5 attempted taking precedes divine taking; 40:21-22 repeat taking after culpable rejection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intention, attempted seizure, truth-displacement, answering seizure, and punishment in that order. I infer a reciprocal causal reversal and identify it as the content of dأb. A live alternative is that dأb names only the peoples' fate, not their conduct.

changed_reading.before: Dأb is an unspecified custom or an unspecified fate of former peoples.
changed_reading.after: Dأb is read as a sustained coercive program whose own seizure-and-displacement logic returns upon its collective agents.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first joins recompense to what each soul acquired and repeats no injustice, then limits recompense for an evil deed to its like while allowing good reward beyond account. This turns focus مثل from loose historical resemblance toward a proportionality ceiling on adverse return.

activation_trace.role: Likeness is the focus anchor that can be sharpened into measured correspondence.
Wrong placement supplies the mismatch that proportional recompense avoids.
Answering an act with its recompense provides the return relation.
Acquisition locates the input to recompense in the acting soul.
The repeated denial of rights-blocking explicitly qualifies individual recompense.
Counting makes the relation inspectably measured rather than arbitrary.
Deliberate action supplies both the adverse and beneficial inputs to the rule.
Recompense is expressly attached to the evil act before the likeness limit.
The same likeness branch directly caps adverse recompense at correspondence.
The negated account on the good side creates an asymmetry: harm is bounded while bounty can exceed measure.

structural_cues: 40:17 repeats لا ظلم immediately after each soul is recompensed for what it acquired.
40:40 says an evil act is recompensed only with its like, but the good are provided for without account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two explicit act-to-return formulas and the second occurrence of مثل. I carry that proportional rule back into the historical comparison and infer a ceiling on adverse return. A live alternative is that focus مثل remains only an analogy of events, with proportionality confined to 40:40.

changed_reading.before: مثل only says that one historical calamity resembles another.
changed_reading.after: مثل also signals measured correspondence: the warning outcome answers acquired action without punitive excess, while beneficial return is not similarly capped.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before and around the warning cycle, the surah repeatedly supplies forgiveness that shields from an act's effect, mercy, protection, and habitual return. These exits make the condemned dأb a persisted course through available reversals rather than inherited or automatic doom.

activation_trace.role: Settled habit is the focus condition whose apparent inevitability is being revised.
Shielding the offender from the effect of the offense supplies a real exit from consequence.
Merciful tenderness supplies the positive orientation of the offered exit.
Protective deflection shows that a threatened effect can be prevented.
Habitual return supplies the counter-course by which settled practice can be interrupted.

structural_cues: 40:3 names forgiveness and accepted return before severe punishment.
40:7-9 asks protection for those who turn and follow, and 40:13 restricts recollection to one who returns.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forgiveness, mercy, protection, and return before the focus warning. I infer that these are available off-ramps, so culpability lies in maintaining dأb through them. A live alternative is that these mercy scenes are parallel promises, not conditions that redefine the historical pattern.

changed_reading.before: The named peoples move through an inevitable inherited cycle.
changed_reading.after: Their danger lies in persisting until practice hardens into dأb despite live routes of return, forgiveness, and protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later dispute opens the قوم-shaped collective into weak followers and status-seeking leaders. Following creates a binding social relation, yet judgment occurs between servants; shared historical placement therefore does not erase internal agency or relational liability.

activation_trace.role: The people-group anchors the collective scale that the context later disaggregates.
Lack of power marks one internal position within the condemned collective.
Elevated rank and leadership mark the opposed position that organized following.
Loyal succession supplies the social bond joining weak followers to leaders.
A liability that follows makes the bond consequential rather than merely descriptive.
Judgment among people supplies adjudication across the collective's internal relations.
The relation between parties keeps their positions distinct even inside a shared outcome.
Common servant-status places both ranks under one judge without making their roles identical.

structural_cues: 40:47 stages direct accusation between followers and the arrogant inside a shared fire.
40:48 answers with judgment between the servants, preserving both common fate and internal distinction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed ranks, a following relation, shared placement, and judgment between servants. I infer that قوم is a responsibility network rather than a guilt-blob. A live alternative is that the exchange stresses only the leaders' inability to alter a fully shared sentence.

changed_reading.before: Whole peoples receive one undifferentiated collective fate.
changed_reading.after: The collective dأb is socially structured by leadership and following, and judgment addresses relations among participants rather than erasing them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence says God sees the servants, then protects the believing speaker while enclosing Pharaoh's house in the evil they devised. The non-zulm clause becomes discriminating sight and protection inside a threatened society, not merely aggregate acquittal after destruction.

activation_trace.role: Servant relation anchors the people toward whom non-injustice is asserted.
Rights-blocking names the harm from which discriminating protection matters.
Actual seeing supplies attention to particular servants rather than an unseen mass.
The repeated servant term directly reconnects divine sight to the focus clause.
Protective deflection supplies the concrete treatment of the exposed believer.
Evil descending around its agents supplies the contrasting return upon Pharaoh's house.

structural_cues: 40:44 moves from the believer's entrusted speech to God's sight of the servants.
40:45 immediately differentiates the protected believer from Pharaoh's house enclosed by harmful return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine sight, individual protection, and enclosing return in immediate sequence. I infer that non-zulm entails discrimination within a collective crisis. A live alternative is that the episode illustrates special protection without defining the full scope of للعباد.

changed_reading.before: Servants are an undifferentiated population assured of abstract fairness.
changed_reading.after: Servants are individually visible within the collective pattern: protection can separate a faithful dissenter while a coercive house receives its own enclosing harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: Some promised outcomes may be shown and others may follow death and return; likewise some messenger cases are narrated and others omitted, before a truth-based decisive judgment. The after-them series is therefore sampled and temporally open, not a demand that every recurrence be immediately visible.

activation_trace.role: Succession after what came before anchors the focus ayah's open historical series.
Exemplary sign permits narrated cases to stand for a wider series.
A promise bounded by an appointed time or place supplies deferred manifestation.
Taking the soul marks death as a possible boundary before completion is seen.
Return to what one came from supplies completion beyond immediate historical visibility.
Sequential narration identifies the told messenger cases as selected traces.
Decisive judgment supplies the terminal act even when its timing is deferred.
Correspondence to reality qualifies the terminal judgment as truth-based.

structural_cues: 40:77 contrasts seeing some promised outcome with dying before it and returning.
40:78 contrasts messengers narrated with messengers not narrated, then places judgment at the arrival of God's command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies partial showing, death and return, told and untold cases, then decisive truth-based judgment. I infer that the focus list is evidentiary sampling within deferred completion. A live alternative is that 40:77-78 only consoles the messenger about timing and does not alter the comparison's scope.

changed_reading.before: Every later people must visibly repeat the same disaster in immediate history.
changed_reading.after: The ayah marks an open sequence whose narrated examples reveal a pattern even when other cases are omitted or their settlement is deferred.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement commands travel and inspection of predecessors' outcome, links their acquisitions to failure, and finally names a divine sunna that has passed among the servants. This creates two coordinated regularities: persisted human dأb and a stable divine response, with no-zulm preventing their collapse into arbitrary divine appetite.

activation_trace.role: Continuing human habit supplies one side of the paired regularity.
The denial of rights-blocking governs the correspondence between conduct and response.
A traversed way or course makes historical regularity something that can be investigated.
Directed perception turns predecessors' remains into inspectable evidence.
The terminal outcome supplies the observable end of the recurring course.
Their own acquisition supplies the human input whose accumulated power fails to save them.
The absence of benefit at belated recognition marks the closure point of the course.
A running, followed way supplies the divine regularity paired with human dأb.
Passing time and vanished generations connect that sunna to the historical series.
The repeated servants anchor the closing sunna directly back to the focus clause.
Real loss supplies the stable result once the course reaches closure.

structural_cues: 40:82 closely repeats the predecessor, greater-strength, earthly-traces, and outcome frame already used at 40:21.
40:83-84 inserts messenger evidence, self-satisfied knowledge, ridicule, and belief only after seeing force.
40:85 names the passing sunna among God's servants and closes with loss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an inspectable predecessor sequence and a closing divine sunna among the same servants. I infer a two-sided correspondence: human habit persists and divine response remains stable. A live alternative is that dأb itself denotes the peoples' received fate, which would blur rather than separate the two sides.

changed_reading.before: Dأb is either only the peoples' habit or only the calamity that happened to them.
changed_reading.after: The verse holds together two nonidentical regularities: a persisted human mode and a stable divine response, whose correspondence is governed by the denial of zulm.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because عاد is first a proper tribal name, not an instruction to derive return or counting from it. It remains packet-valid because the focus inventory explicitly preserves the proper-name branch alongside return and count mappings, and later return language activates those mappings. Downstream prose should present this only as a branch-level resonance or wordplay, never as the lexical replacement of the tribal name.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عاد at 40:31 word 5, followed by والذين من بعدهم

activation_trace.role: The proper-name branch preserves Aad as the primary lexical identification.
Return after departure adds a recurrence resonance without displacing the name.
The split count mapping lets the named case sound like one enumerated unit in a series.
The common return activates recurrence as a live surah-wide movement.
The packet's non-dominant count target adds recurrence at appointed times around the promise.
Explicit return reinforces the serial-return resonance activated at the focus name.

changed_reading.before: Aad is merely one named item in a historical list.
changed_reading.after: While remaining the tribe Aad, the packet's split branches let the name act as a counted return-hinge inside the extending after-them sequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because it carries the focus branch for putting something in the wrong place or time into the later creation sequence. It remains anchored in ظلم and is supported by measured creation, attached gestation, staged growth, attainment, and an appointed term. Downstream prose should qualify it as a material-temporal analogy, not claim that the ayah lexically defines all injustice as biological mistiming.

activation_trace.role: Wrong placement or timing supplies the precise focus branch explored by the outlier.
The servants anchor the developmental material back to the humans named in the focus clause.
Measured proportion and estimation supply an ordered rather than misplaced origin.
The seminal drop supplies one materially bounded stage in the sequence.
A pregnancy established in the womb supplies attachment in its fitting locus.
The young child marks a distinct stage rather than an undifferentiated life span.
Reaching a goal supplies ordered transitions toward maturity and term.
An appointed duration supplies the fitting temporal boundary of the process.

changed_reading.before: Zulm denotes only moral or judicial unfairness.
changed_reading.after: Zulm can additionally evoke anti-misplacement: divine dealing with servants is imaged against forcing life into a wrong stage, locus, or appointed time.

strongest_changes: 40:5 specifies dأb as persisted coercion and truth-displacement whose seizure logic returns upon its agents.
40:17 and 40:40 sharpen مثل into a proportionality ceiling on adverse recompense under the repeated denial of zulm.
40:44-48 make servants individually visible and socially differentiated inside collective judgment.
40:82-85 pair human dأb with a stable divine sunna while the focus denial of zulm keeps the two regularities nonidentical.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet did not merely add more destroyed peoples. It exposed an ordered mechanism of persistence, offered return, calibrated recompense, internal social roles, deferred completion, and a closing sunna among the same servants.
remaining_uncertainties: Dأb may lexically lean toward the peoples' conduct, their received fate, or the recurrent complex of both.
The Aad return-and-count activation is deliberately contained because the proper name remains primary.
The developmental anti-misplacement reading is a branch-guided material analogy rather than a direct lexical gloss.
The follower-leader scene proves internal differentiation, but the exact distribution of liability remains unstated.
